_meta.purpose: PUBLIC dictionary for recognising lab markers in the text of a report (per-language name substrings → the labs.json key, units, references). Feeds the auto-ingest of a folder of lab PDFs. Holds no patient data, portable.
_meta.note:
labels.<lang> holds everything that is a language: names — lower-case substrings to look for in a row of the form; exclude — if one occurs, the row is skipped; require / next_require / form_require and their negatives — the same, scoped to the segment after the name, to the next row, and to the form as a whole; display — the name shown on screen. A language absent from a marker falls back to one that is present.
Language-independent, and deliberately outside labels: unit (a UCUM code — the label for it comes from knowledge/units.json in the output language), units ({unit surface form: multiplier to the canonical unit} — at once a gate and a conversion, populated only where a conversion is genuinely needed), specimen (blood/serum/plasma/urine/stool/saliva), the reference bounds, direction, plausible, loinc.

cholesterol_total.convert_note: Cholesterol M = 386.65 g/mol; 1 mg/dL = 10/386.65 = 0.02586 mmol/L. The same constant applies to the LDL and HDL fractions — they are cholesterol, measured in a fraction.

triglycerides.convert_note: Triolein M = 885.4 g/mol; 1 mg/dL = 10/885.4 = 0.01129 mmol/L. Note this is NOT the cholesterol constant — a common substitution, and it overstates triglycerides by a factor of 2.3.

insulin.convert_note: The WHO standard gives 1 µIU/mL = 6.00 pmol/L, hence 1 pmol/L = 0.1667 µIU/mL. Unlike the molar conversions this one rests on a standard preparation, not on a molar mass — a different insulin standard changes it.

convert_refused.mmol/mol: the IFCC scale relates to NGSP % by an affine formula (% = 0.0915 × mmol/mol + 2.15), not by a multiplier: 48 mmol/mol is 6.5 %, and multiplying would give about 4.4 %.

uric_acid.convert_note: Uric acid M = 168.11 g/mol; 1 mg/dL = 10000/168.11 = 59.48 µmol/L.

testosterone.convert_note: Testosterone M = 288.42 g/mol; 1 ng/dL = 10/288.42 = 0.03467 nmol/L, 1 ng/mL = 3.467 nmol/L. The two spellings differ by a factor of 100.

vitamin_d.convert_note: 25-OH-vitamin D3 M = 400.6 g/mol; 1 nmol/L = 400.6/1000 = 0.4006 ng/mL. The parser's own `units` map rounds this to 0.4; typed input uses the full constant, and the difference at 75 nmol/L is 0.04 ng/mL.

ferritin.convert_note: 1 ng/mL = 1 µg/L exactly — the same quantity under two names, and worth listing so that the commoner spelling is not refused.

tsh.convert_note: 1 µIU/mL = 1 mIU/L exactly. Both spellings are in wide use on forms and in reference ranges, and neither is a conversion.

note.en: The reference range of the CLIA kit on this laboratory's forms: 5.0–26.0 IU/mL (the lower bound is the limit of quantification, not a «deficiency»). Only the upper bound is kept in the profile.
note.ru: Референс набора ИХЛА в бланках лаборатории: 5,0–26,0 МЕ/мл (нижняя граница — предел количественного определения, не «дефицит»). В профиле фиксируется только верхняя граница.

folate.convert_note: Folic acid M = 441.4 g/mol; 1 ng/mL = 1000/441.4 = 2.266 nmol/L.

note.en: Immunoassay (pmol/L). The LC-MS/MS method reports nmol/L (<0.09) — the units may conflict when the series is reconciled, and that needs a manual check.
note.ru: Иммуноанализ (пмоль/л). Метод ЖХ-МС/МС даёт нмоль/л (<0,09) — при сверке возможен конфликт единиц, требует ручной проверки.

note.ru: Прямой иммуноанализ (пг/мл). Расчётный по Vermeulen — отдельный ключ free_testosterone_calc.

hematocrit.convert_note: A volume fraction and a percentage of the same quantity: 0.45 L/L is 45 %. US analysers print either.

rbc.convert_note: 10⁶ per microlitre IS 10¹² per litre — a factor of exactly 1. Same reasoning as for the leucocyte count.

platelets.convert_note: 10³ per microlitre IS 10⁹ per litre — a factor of exactly 1, not a conversion. The US spellings (K/uL, K/µL) and the caret form (10^9/L) name the same quantity as the canonical 10*9/L; refusing them refuses the panel, not the unit.

wbc.convert_note: 10³ per microlitre IS 10⁹ per litre — a factor of exactly 1, not a conversion. The US spellings (K/uL, K/µL) and the caret form (10^9/L) name the same quantity as the canonical 10*9/L; refusing them refuses the panel, not the unit.

sodium.convert_note: Sodium is monovalent, so mEq/L and mmol/L are numerically the same. Listed rather than assumed: the equality holds for the monovalent ions and not for calcium or magnesium on the same panel.

urea.convert_note: Urea M = 60.06 g/mol; 1 mg/dL = 10/60.06 = 0.1665 mmol/L. BUN counts nitrogen only (2 × 14.007 = 28.01), so 1 mg/dL BUN = 10/28.01 = 0.357 mmol/L of urea — more than twice as much. Which one a lab reports is not visible in the number.

magnesium_blood.convert_note: Canonical here is mg/L. Magnesium A = 24.305 g/mol, divalent: 1 mEq/L = 12.15 mg/L.

calcium_blood.convert_note: Canonical here is mg/L. Calcium A = 40.08 g/mol and it is divalent: 1 mEq/L = 20.04 mg/L. The molar entry (×40.08) is in `units` already.

convert_refused.mg/dL: mass and molar concentration of Lp(a) do not relate by a constant: the apo(a) isoform varies in size between people (kringle IV type-2 repeats), so mg/dL → nmol/L needs a factor that depends on the person's isoform. Published approximations range from about 2.0 to 2.5 and are explicitly not for clinical conversion. Enter the nmol/L figure the laboratory reported, or keep the mg/dL series separately.

note.en: Stool pH from the coprogram. The form's normal range is 6.5–7.5; a shift to the acid side is fermentative dyspepsia, to the alkaline side putrefactive.
note.ru: pH кала из копрограммы. Норма бланка 6,5–7,5; сдвиг в кислую сторону — бродильная диспепсия, в щелочную — гнилостная.

note.en: 0 = negative/not found, 1 = positive. The norm here is POSITIVE: the absence of stercobilin speaks of disturbed bile flow. The scale here is inverted relative to the other qualitative markers.
note.ru: 0 = отрицательный/не обнаружен, 1 = положительный. Норма — ПОЛОЖИТЕЛЬНЫЙ: отсутствие стеркобилина говорит о нарушении поступления жёлчи. Шкала здесь перевёрнута относительно остальных качественных показателей.

note.en: 0 = not found (normal), 1 = found. Bilirubin in the stool of an adult is a sign of accelerated transit or of suppressed microflora (normally all of it is reduced to stercobilin).
note.ru: 0 = не обнаружен (норма), 1 = обнаружен. Билирубин в кале у взрослого — признак ускоренного транзита или подавленной микрофлоры (в норме он весь восстановлен до стеркобилина).

note.en: A rapid immunochromatographic test. 0 = negative (normal), 1 = POSITIVE. A positive result is a reason to discuss colonoscopy with a doctor, not to watch and wait.
note.ru: Иммунохроматографический экспресс-тест. 0 = отрицательный (норма), 1 = ПОЛОЖИТЕЛЬНЫЙ. Положительный результат — показание к обсуждению колоноскопии с врачом, а не к самонаблюдению.

note.en: Semi-quantitative scale of the coprogram: 0 = not found/absent, 1 = scant/single, 2 = a few, 3 = moderate, 4 = many/abundant. The worded result of the form is converted into this ordinal score, otherwise the marker does not join a series and is not comparable between draws.
